title: Pope Leo Returns to Rome After 12-Day South America Tour, Says He Feels "in Fairly Good Shape"
detail: Pope Leo XIV landed in Rome on Nov 17 after a roughly 14-15 hour flight from Lima, ending the Uruguay-Argentina-Peru tour, his first major trip since the Oct 13 lung surgery and adenocarcinoma diagnosis. AFP-based coverage said the tour eased doubts about his recovery; Leo said he felt "in fairly good shape" and never doubted going ahead. No new medical bulletin, staging or treatment plan was reported.

media.caption: Pope Leo dispels health concerns with marathon South America tour
